checks.command: python3 -c 'import json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys; h=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get("HERMES_HOME",pathlib.Path.home()/".hermes")); s=h/"curate-memory/state.json"; s=s if s.exists() else h/"memory-request-review/state.json"; p=subprocess.run([os.environ.get("HERMES_MEMORY_REVIEW_PYTHON","python3"),os.path.expanduser(os.environ.get("THESYSTEM_WORKSPACE","~/workspace")+"/agents/skills/curate-memory/scripts/review_memory_requests.py"),"learn","--home-root",str(h)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30); ok=p.returncode==0; data=json.loads(p.stdout) if ok else {}; decisions=data.get("decision_types",{}); print("OK learning summary: %d decision types"%len(decisions) if ok and isinstance(decisions,dict) else "FAIL learning summary unavailable"); sys.exit(0 if ok and isinstance(decisions,dict) else 1)'

safe_state.switch: hold the learning state file unchanged
safe_state.description: Do not migrate, edit, or prune decision history automatically; unreadable history may contain human decisions that are not recoverable elsewhere.

sampling.what: Daily learning-summary availability and count of decision types, without proposal text or mismatch reasons.
sampling.working_well: The learn command reads the current or legacy state path and returns a structured decision summary without exposing decision contents.

open_decisions: Decide whether an absent state file means a valid empty learning history or an initialization problem; the current CLI treats it as empty.
